pollIntervalSec.description: 轮询间隔（秒），最小 60，实际会加 0–20% 随机抖动

en.description: Polling interval in seconds, at least 60; adds 0–20% random jitter.

sendMode.description: 出站模式：review=AI 回复只进草稿队列，master 用 bili-draft send <id> 审批后才发出（默认）；off=禁止出站。不提供自动直发

en.description: Outbound mode: review (default) queues AI replies as drafts; a master approves each send with the bili-draft send command. off disables outbound messages. Automatic direct replies are not supported.

minSendIntervalSec.description: 审批后两次真实发送的最小间隔（秒），最小 10；不足时拒绝发送，不排队

en.description: Minimum interval between approved sends in seconds (at least 10). Sending too soon is rejected, not queued.

notifications.description: 额外轮询的通知：reply=回复我的，at=@我的（需要 Cookie；只收视频评论）。默认不开

en.description: Additional notifications to poll: reply (replies to me) and at (mentions). Requires cookies; video comments only. Disabled by default.

notificationScope.description: 通知入站范围：whitelist=只收 videos 白名单视频下的通知（默认）；all=所有视频评论通知

en.description: Notification scope: whitelist (default) accepts only configured videos; all accepts notifications from any video.

dataDir.description: 本地数据目录：待审草稿与扫码登录凭据存在 <dataDir>/<endpoint id>/ 下（相对进程工作目录），重启不丢。不要放进仓库

en.description: Local data directory. Pending drafts and QR-login credentials are stored under <dataDir>/<endpoint id>/ (relative to the working directory) and survive restarts. Keep it out of the repository.

notify.description: 有新草稿或登录失效时，主动发消息提醒到这个聊天会话（通常是你和机器人的私聊）。不填则只在 Console「评论审批」页和日志里看到

en.description: Chat conversation to notify when a new draft arrives or the login expires (usually your private chat with the bot). Without it, drafts only appear on the Console Comment review page and in logs.
Adapter name, such as icqq or telegram.
Endpoint id of that adapter.
Conversation type.

id.description: 会话 id：私聊填你的账号，群聊填群号

en.description: Conversation id: your account for a private chat, or the group id.

videos.description: 白名单视频：BV 号或 av 号。只轮询这些视频的评论，不做全站搜索

en.description: Allowed videos, using BV or av IDs. Only comments on these videos are polled; no site-wide search.

master.description: 框架 master（B 站 uid）。endpoints[i].master 可逐项覆盖

en.description: Framework masters (Bilibili uid). endpoints[i].master can override this value.

items.description: 信任的 Bilibili 用户 ID

en.description: Trusted Bilibili user ID

trusted.description: 框架 trusted 用户列表（B 站 uid）

en.description: Framework trusted users (Bilibili uid).

commandPrefix.description: 命令前缀（默认 '' 无前缀，任意文本按命令匹配；如 '/' 要求 / 开头）。endpoints[i] 可逐项覆盖

en.description: Command prefix. The default empty string allows unprefixed commands; '/' requires a leading slash. Each endpoints[i] can override it.

endpoints.description: 多账号：一个插件实例挂多个 endpoint。每项与顶层字段同构（id 必填，其余覆盖顶层）

id.description: Endpoint 名称（本地标识，不是 B 站账号）

en.description: Local endpoint name, not a Bilibili account ID.

sessdata.description: Cookie SESSDATA（以你的账号身份操作；请用 ${BILIBILI_SESSDATA} 注入，切勿写入仓库）

en.description: SESSDATA cookie, acting as your account. Reference ${BILIBILI_SESSDATA}; never commit it to the repository.

biliJct.description: Cookie bili_jct（csrf token；请用 ${BILIBILI_BILI_JCT} 注入）

en.description: bili_jct cookie (CSRF token). Reference ${BILIBILI_BILI_JCT}.
